title: Scripture and Culture
definition: Scripture and culture must be rightly ordered because God's Word judges every culture while also speaking redemptively into every people and place.
summary: God's Word speaks with authority over every culture and calls believers to faithful witness within it.
christFocus: Jesus sends His people into the world while keeping them anchored in His truth.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Every culture contains both reflections of God's common grace and expressions of human sin. Scripture gives believers the ability to receive what is good, reject what is evil, and bear witness faithfully.

The Church must not be conformed to the world, yet it must not withdraw from mission. God's Word equips believers to live as faithful witnesses in real cultural settings.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Culture often feels normal even when it contradicts God. Scripture and culture matters because believers need a standard higher than the age they live in.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask where your assumptions come from. Let Scripture correct cultural habits, priorities, and values while helping you love people wisely in the world.
